verified_facts.text: The resort is a short walk from Disneyland Park, Disney California Adventure Park and Downtown Disney District.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort is just a short walk from Disneyland Park, Disney California Adventure Park, and Downtown Disney District

verified_facts.text: A private pathway connects the hotel to Anaheim GardenWalk, with its restaurants, shops and entertainment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just steps from our doors and easy to reach via our private pathway, Anaheim GardenWalk is the city’s epicenter of outdoor dining and entertainment.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a Disneyland Resort Good Neighbor Hotel that can help with multi-day Disneyland Resort Park Hopper tickets through its concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: As a Disneyland Good Neighbor Hotel, we offer special vacation packages and can assist with multi-day Disneyland Resort Park Hopper® tickets through our concierge or online booking.

verified_facts.text: Parkestry Rooftop Bar & Lounge offers sweeping skyline views and, on select nights, views of the Disneyland fireworks.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Parkestry Rooftop Bar & Lounge, our elevated outdoor oasis, take in sweeping skyline views as the evening unfolds—on select nights, culminating in Disneyland® fireworks lighting up the sky.

verified_facts.text: The tenth-floor Executive Lounge has a wraparound terrace with views over Anaheim and the nightly Disney fireworks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Platinum, titanium, and ambassador Bonvoy members have full access to the tenth-floor Executive Lounge. Step onto the wraparound terrace for splendid views of the entire city of Anaheim and nightly Disney fireworks.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor heated pool is open year-round and has luxury cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: With an outdoor heated pool, open year-round, complete with three large luxury cabanas

verified_facts.text: The resort grows its own herbs and produce in the JW Garden for use in dishes and drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: At our resort we grow our own herbs and produce for use in dishes, drinks, and more

verified_facts.text: The JW Garden is also a Pollinator Garden of California native plants that support local wildlife.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our garden also serves as a thriving Pollinator Garden, featuring California native plants that support local wildlife

verified_facts.text: Bunk Bed Suites have a twin-top and queen-bottom bunk so children get their own space.
verified_facts.excerpt: For families, our Bunk Bed Suites offer a playful and practical setup featuring a twin‑top bunk and queen‑bottom bunk—giving kids their own cozy space

verified_facts.text: The Family Bunkbed Suite can sleep up to six people in two separate bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Families looking for even more room will love the Family Bunkbed Suite, which can sleep up to six people in two separate bedrooms.

verified_facts.text: Every room has a large walk-in shower with a stand-alone bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: every room features a large walk-in shower with a stand-alone bathtub

verified_facts.text: Some rooms and suites have views of the nearby theme parks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Select rooms and suites offer trundle beds or bunk beds, perfect for accommodating little ones, while others boast enchanting views of the nearby theme parks.

verified_facts.text: Tocca Ferro Italian Chophouse follows a seed-to-table philosophy, making dishes from scratch, including hand-rolled pasta and dry-aged beef.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooted in a sustainable seed-to-table philosophy. Each dish is crafted from scratch, from hand-rolled pasta and dry-aged beef

verified_facts.text: Tocca Ferro's dining room, inspired by Southern California's farming and equestrian heritage, blends rustic elegance with iron accents and weathered glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by Southern California’s farming and equestrian heritage, the dining room blends rustic elegance with iron accents, weathered glass

verified_facts.text: Family events run through the week, such as cookie decorating on Thursdays and movie nights on Saturdays.
verified_facts.excerpt: family events take place throughout the week, like cookie decorating on Thursdays and movie nights on Saturdays.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes and state-of-the-art equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: access to an expansive fitness center featuring Peloton bikes and state-of-the-art equipment

verified_facts.text: A Yoga and Zen Room offers in-person and digital classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: a rejuvenating Yoga and Zen Room featuring in-person and digital classes

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are marble, with a separate tub and shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marble bathrooms feature a separate tub and shower.

verified_facts.text: Executive Lounge access is complimentary for Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elite members.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, Titanium, and Ambassador Elite members receive complimentary lounge access during their stay.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott, Anaheim Resort.
